title: Divide et Impera: Multi-Transformer Architectures for Complex NLP-Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating debiasing performance using F1 scores for bias classification, extraction, and text reformulation against a test dataset derived from Wikipedia neutral point of view (NPOV) edits. Additionally, quantifying bias reduction using Mean Squared Word Neutrality (MSWN) via GloVe word embeddings, measuring the cosine similarity between specific words (e.g., professions and descriptions) and a gender direction defined by the 'she-he' subspace.
